spans.s: देश lit. place; (l) original place of articulation: cf. अदेशे वा वचनं व्यञ्ज- नस्य, R. Pr.
; (2) place of origin; उच्चारणस्थान: (3) place of inferential establishment of a Paribhasa etc. परिभाषादेशः उद्देशः Par. Sek. pari. 2,3; (4) passage of the Samhita text, cf..T. Pr.
देशीयर् tad. affix देशीय in the sense of slightly less, or almost similar, optionally prescribed with the affixes कल्प and देश्य e. g. मृदुकल्पः, मृदुदेश्यः. मृदुदशीयः cf.Kas, on

देश्य (l) tad. affix in the sense of almost similar; see देशीयर् above; (2) (words) current in popular use or language, although not sanction- ed by rules of grammar; cf. देश्याः सूत्रनिबन्धाः क्रियन्ते M.Bh. on
: cf. देश्या देष्टव्याः साधुत्वेन प्रतिपाद्या:, Kaiyata on

; probably Kaiyata had a difficulty in ex- plaining the word देश्य in the old way meaning ' current in use', as many words called bad words, introduced from other languages were current at his time which he was reluctant to term देश्य.
